sources.title: Muse Wonder: A Frontier Model For Personal & Professional AI Agents
sources.evidence: The October 12, 2026 announcement releases Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, with Full available to Muse Code subscribers. It describes pretraining and reinforcement learning, larger base models than Spark, long-running coding tasks, and reasoning-effort comparisons, but gives no parameter count or production architecture.

sources.title: Muse Wonder Model Card
sources.evidence: The current 13-page card explicitly names both Wonder and Wonder Full. Its shared model table gives Meta as provider, October 12, 2026 release, text/image/video/audio input, text output, and 1M inference context. It documents reasoning and tool-based evaluations, including Full at max and SWE-Marathon at xhigh. It contains no parameter or architecture specification.

sources.title: Models - Meta Model API
sources.evidence: The availability table identifies Full as a distinct higher-capability variant available only in Muse Code on Power Usage and Maximum Usage subscriptions. Max effort on ordinary Wonder does not select Full. The precise 1,048,576-token limit and PDF input appear in the ordinary Wonder API description.

sources.title: Muse Wonder | Meta
sources.evidence: The Full-specific product block and muse-wonder-full-1.0 pricing row list 1M context and subscription-only Muse Code access. The page explicitly associates Full with Active Memory and Active Focus, and separately labels Wonder and Full benchmark columns.

sources.title: Put your ideas to work with Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full
sources.evidence: The October 12 launch confirms Full is exclusive to Muse Code subscriptions and describes the series as supporting multistep reasoning, sequential tool invocation, error recovery, coding and multimodal understanding. It explicitly assigns Active Memory and Active Focus to the series. Audio support on a particular release surface requires separate confirmation.

sources.title: Meta Model API Terms of Service
sources.evidence: The October 9, 2026 terms cover coding-harness subscriptions as well as model services. They grant limited access/use rights and retain service ownership for Meta or its licensors; separate open-weight licenses are distinct. Together with Full-only subscription distribution, this supports a proprietary classification.

sources.title: Muse Spark Open Model Card
sources.evidence: The later October 15 card and comparison tables were checked for an exact Wonder Full specification. They have no Wonder entry. The 816B total, 42B active and MoE Transformer description are explicitly for Spark Open and cannot establish Wonder Full parameters or architecture.

sources.title: Models.dev Muse Wonder Full record
sources.evidence: The upstream comment explains that its 1,048,576 context number expands the card’s 1M using other Muse documentation. It also notes Full has no API reference and that ordinary Wonder API format lists do not establish Full input formats. Used to trace the baseline assertion, not verify it.

developer.note: The provider is Meta Platforms, Inc. or Meta Platforms Ireland Limited.

family.note: Normalized Muse family grouping; Full belongs to the Wonder series.

open_weights.note: Official distribution is exclusive to Muse Code subscriptions, with no Full weight release.

license.note: Descriptive classification for the hosted subscription model under Meta service terms; no open-weight license is assigned to Full.

parameters_b.note: No Full total is reported. Exact-name searches for later technical/training and comparison material did not locate a disclosure; Spark Open counts are not transferable.

active_parameters_b.note: No Full active count or routing specification is reported; do not infer an active count from a different model.

architecture.note: Pretraining/RL and larger base models do not specify production architecture. Targeted training/interpretability searches found no Full-specific structural disclosure; Spark Open MoE is separate.

context_window.note: Nominal 1M, explicitly scoped to Full in its product row and shared card. The exact Full token ceiling is not disclosed; 1,048,576 belongs to ordinary Wonder documentation and was transferred by the catalog.

modalities.note: Shared card explicitly covers Full. These are model modalities, not confirmed Muse Code file formats or direct audio-upload support. PDF is not imported from ordinary Wonder API docs.

reasoning.note: Full evaluations explicitly use reasoning effort. Full is a separate model, not an effort setting on the ordinary API model.

tool_call.note: The series capability description explicitly includes sequential tool invocation and recovery from failed calls.

description.value: Meta's multimodal reasoning model for coding, computer use and tasks involving tools, available through Muse Code subscriptions. Full is a separate variant from the Muse Wonder API model.
description.note: Concise supported capabilities and Full-specific subscription access; removes promotional labels while retaining the model-identity distinction.

patch.description: Meta's multimodal reasoning model for coding, computer use and tasks involving tools, available through Muse Code subscriptions. Full is a separate variant from the Muse Wonder API model.

sources.label: Meta Wonder and Wonder Full model card
Meta model availability and variant distinction

patch.notes: Full is subscription-only in Muse Code, not the ordinary Wonder API model at high or max reasoning effort. Context is the explicitly published nominal 1M; an exact Full limit of 1,048,576 is not established. Model-card audio modality does not establish direct audio support on every release surface, and PDF support is not transferred from ordinary Wonder API documentation. Full total parameters, active parameters and production architecture remain undisclosed in the primary material checked; Spark Open counts and architecture do not apply.

summary: Audited all 14 fields against exact-variant primary material. Added proprietary license classification, corrected unsupported exact context precision to the published nominal 1M, and clarified Full-only Muse Code access and its distinction from ordinary Wonder reasoning effort. Confirmed October 12 release and model-card modalities, reasoning and tool use. Total/active parameters and architecture remain undisclosed after the current card, training discussion, targeted research searches and later Spark Open comparison-card review.
